purpose: Evaluate the frozen Post-Inference Diagnostic Reliability Layer on the previously untouched scenario-level holdout partition without further model or policy development.
research_question_comparison: Compare upstream evidence-readiness alone (M_E) with the selected combined upstream and downstream reliability estimator (M_EU).

primary_outcome.name: Y_D
primary_outcome.rationale: Primary diagnostic correctness is defined only for substantive modal diagnoses.

evaluation_population.known_compatibility_limitation: No Y_D-eligible MEMORY_PRESSURE cases are present in the holdout.

metrics.calibration_notes: Calibration diagnostics are interpreted cautiously because the holdout contains only 54 Y_D-eligible cases and 11 positive outcomes.

paired_model_comparison.purpose: Assess incremental information from downstream uncertainty beyond upstream evidence readiness.

uncertainty_analysis.invalid_discrimination_replicates: Replicates lacking both outcome classes are excluded from the corresponding discrimination metric interval and counted.

feature_level_checks: UNKNOWN modal diagnosis maps to ABSTAIN without a reliability probability.
Substantive E=0 cases map to WITHHOLD.
Substantive E=1 cases with predicted reliability below 0.64 map to QUALIFY.
Substantive E=1 cases with predicted reliability at or above 0.64 map to ISSUE.
post_holdout_prohibitions: rerunning the main experiment in response to holdout performance
interpretation_constraints: Brier score remains the primary model-comparison metric.
Supporting metrics do not replace the pre-specified primary metric.
The holdout is a final evaluation sample, not a new development set.
Failure to outperform M_E on the holdout is retained as a research result rather than tuned away.
The 0.64 Issue threshold is a development-stage prototype operating criterion, not an externally validated safety guarantee.
